paid-speaking.route: Guest-speaker work-permit exemption (single or occasional event, up to 10 days); otherwise a work permit
paid-speaking.detail: Cayman Immigration Regulations: a guest speaker at a single or occasional conference or seminar that isn't part of a commercial venture is exempt from a work permit for up to 10 days, with no other gainful activity. Repeated short business visits use a Business Visitor's Permit.
paid-speaking.next: Have the organiser confirm with WORC that the event qualifies for the guest-speaker exemption.

seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: July, September and October. Driest: February, March and April. Hottest: July (29.3°C average). Coolest: January (25.8°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.

laws.rule: Religion and family are of significant cultural importance across the Cayman Islands. Many shops, banks and services close on Sundays.
laws.heading: Sunday trading

laws.rule: There are harsh penalties for those caught with drugs of any kind. Penalties can include imprisonment for up to 35 years, and fines of unlimited amounts.
laws.heading: Illegal drugs and prison sentences

laws.rule: Same-sex civil partnerships were legalised in 2020. Hotels and resorts are generally welcoming, regardless of sexual orientation. Local attitudes can be conservative and some people may not approve of same-sex couples showing affection in public. Read more advice for LGBT+ travellers .
laws.heading: LGBT+ travellers
